source.summary: A (mock) paper explaining why therapies that work for soluble-enzyme NCLs may not work for CLN3.

target.label: CLN3 disease
target.summary: The most common form of Batten disease. It usually starts at school age with vision loss, followed by seizures and loss of skills.
